`2021 – 2024`

**Topics:** mergers & acquisitions · ESG risk · EHS compliance

**My contributions:** site inspections, document reviews, stakeholder interviews, risk reporting and action plans (ESAP)

**Skills used:** ISO standards, IFC Performance Standards, ADB and AIIB policies

## Overview

Before investing in or acquiring a company, investors need a clear picture of its environmental, social, governance and health & safety risks. I conducted due diligence (EDD, ESDD, ESG DD, EHS DD) and prepared Environmental & Social Action Plans (ESAP) across **7+ manufacturing-sector projects**, benchmarking against ISO, IFC PS, ADB and AIIB standards.

## Selected engagements (2023)

- **ESDD**, Energy Efficiency Platform, Singapore
- **ESDD**, coffee farm and supply chain, Southern Vietnam
- **ESG DD**, semiconductor manufacturing, Bac Giang Province, Vietnam
- **EHS DD**, plastic manufacturing plant, Bac Ninh Province, Vietnam

## My role

- Conducted site inspections, document reviews and stakeholder interviews
- Assessed environmental, social, governance and HSE compliance risk
- Produced actionable mitigation reports that informed client investment decisions
